caption: The image is a monochromatic pencil drawing featuring a single, symmetrical object that appears to be a decorative or ceremonial vessel on a pedestal base. The central object is vertically oriented and consists of a wide, rounded body that tapers both upward and downward. The top of the vessel has a small, flat neck with two straight, parallel protrusions extending upward from the opening. The vessel transitions into a narrower, spindle-like stem that connects to a broad, flared, tiered base. The object displays subtle shading to suggest a three-dimensional form with smooth, rounded surfaces. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small, outlined version of the same object, demonstrating its overall proportions with arrows indicating height and width. The background is a light beige tone, and the entire composition is framed by a thin rectangular border. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner as "H. Zeidenberg."
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
